note: Spec 1 evidence pack drafted by Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5). Every quote was checked by script as verbatim in the guideline PDF text (ignoring line breaks and ligatures). Dose amounts and deny-listed product names in the guideline were left out (Rule 4).
why: A head injury can cause confusion, seizures and loss of responsiveness. ERC 2025 'Concussion' is first-aid guidance a non-doctor can follow; it covers recognising concussion, not severe head trauma.

recommendations.section: Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Concussion
quotes: Suspect a concussion if a person has difficulties with thinking/remembering, displays physical symptoms (headache, change in vision, dizziness, nausea or vomiting, seizures, sensitivity to light/noise), emotional changes or changes in behaviour (increased sleepiness, reduction in normal activities, loss of responsiveness, confusion).
